notes:
V3.1.8 — hotfix for the v3.1.7 startup crash.

Missing QComboBox import in ui/account_tab.py made the new theme picker explode on load — the app couldn't reach the main window. Crash trace:

    File ui/account_tab.py line 207, in _build_theme_picker
    NameError: name 'QComboBox' is not defined

This is a one-line fix (added QComboBox to the PyQt6.QtWidgets import). Sorry — pure tunnel vision while writing _build_theme_picker; should have actually launched v3.1.7 once before publishing.

No functional changes vs v3.1.7 beyond the import. Everything else from v3.1.7 (bulletproof version detection across three embed layers, installer.iss MyAppVersion patching, diagnostic log, window icon, theme picker, admin classify UI) lands again here.
